vetSays.line: 🛡️ Kurt, Colin, Leo, Raj and Meera met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Kurt, Colin, Leo, Raj, Meera are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Colin, Lulwa, Leo and Jorge met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Colin, Lulwa, Leo, Jorge are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kayden, Leo, Raj, Jorge and Meera met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Leo didn't come back. Raj, Jorge, Meera are hurt.
🛡️ Raj, Jorge, Meera, Ingrid and Recep met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Raj, Jorge, Meera, Ingrid, Recep are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Meera just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Benoit just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Meera, Recep, Benoit and Gustave met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Recep, Gustave are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Recep just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
